messages:
priya: FYI nightly_recon shows ~0.9% lost events for ACME-HW via the marketplace proxy. finance wants a playbook to limit credits.

samir: sounds like partner retry storms + proxy backpressure. recommend publishing a retry policy: exponential backoff, jitter, max_retries=5.

maria: can we require x-rw-event-id header and a short-lived HMAC (x-rw-sig) so partners can't rewrite IDs? that'll help trace and dedupe.

alex: agree. also add a tracing span at fanout and one at ingest; join on event_id. we'll surface gaps in the dashboard.

carla: sales wants a standard customer message for cases where partner is at fault. draft should say: "we investigated and found partner delivery issues; no entitlement credit applied; partner to remediate."

billing-bot: automated-report: nightly_recon job complete. total=930,412; lost=8,374; flagged_high_impact=142. https://redwood.prod/recon/1983005678

leo: small fraction of failures are SKU mismatches. we need a shared SKU mapping table and validation rule: reject unknown SKUs early and notify partner.

priya: action list: 1) send partners retry & header spec (priya) 2) infra to add spans + idempotency (alex, ETA 5d) 3) billing to accept canonical reason codes LOST/DUP/LATE/SKU_MISMATCH (billing-bot) 4) draft customer message (carla). I'll follow up with partners today.

maria: thanks all, please post partner responses here and we'll reconvene tomorrow.
